lesson1Content.scopeNote: Lesson 1 currently covers school facilities and classroom vocabulary. Unit-level professions are not injected into Lesson 1.

supportingGrammar.title: Aimer / Préférer
supportingGrammar.scope: J'aime / préfère; Tu aimes / préfères; Il / Elle aime / préfère; Nous aimons / préférons; Vous aimez / préférez; Ils / Elles aiment / préfèrent

supportingGrammar.title: Il y a / Il n'y a pas de
supportingGrammar.scope: Il y a un tableau. → Il n'y a pas de tableau.

audioPolicy: Audio remains embedded inside the interactive lesson file; image click and speaker button both trigger pronunciation.
videoPolicy: Lesson videos are represented as YouTube links and open on click.
assessmentPolicy: The formal assessment and interactive assessment are separate files and must not expose model answers before the student attempts the question.
accuracyPolicy: Lesson-specific content must not inherit unrelated unit vocabulary merely because it appears elsewhere in the curriculum. Visual assets must be mapped to the exact word before publication.
